narrative: All 7 of 7 test cases passed across the full buyer evaluation journey. Every major area is solid: loading a scenario and setting requirement priorities works correctly, vendor agents are discovered and contacted as expected, Ramp and Brex both return evidence-backed answers with cited documentation, the comparison table renders with accurate coverage scores and a clear verdict, priority changes correctly shift the verdict and highlight the deciding requirement, challenging an unresolved requirement produces a meaningful follow-up note, and the sandbox demonstration is correctly labeled as synthetic data with duplicate-removal counts reported. There are no failures or blocked scenarios to report.
